notes: The explicit final HVS/BHB-HVS list is the 18 rows labelled HVS or BHB-HVS in the Appendix (I:p16-b0) and listed in Table 1 (I:p7-b6). I include the 11 low-v sin i objects only conditionally as candidates_found: Table 1 gives p_unbound^MS >50%, while the text says they could be BHBs and none is unbound for that interpretation (T:p6-b3; T:p11-b4). Conditional low-v sin i stars: Gaia DR3 2572040752892873984, Gaia DR3 2648181555159543552, Gaia DR3 3588442637484171008, Gaia DR3 4595082297634366592, Gaia DR3 4581900046572174080, Gaia DR3 2685101029611915136, Gaia DR3 1223081242794074240, Gaia DR3 1577239362641455616, Gaia DR3 5761711276263802112, Gaia DR3 4452514740895387904, Gaia DR3 3861665332750313856. The seven high-v sin i HVS candidates included are Gaia DR3 2515789291339579648, Gaia DR3 3677213628601638656, Gaia DR3 2564538681977454208, Gaia DR3 1890511670168860416, Gaia DR3 4584485956183915776, Gaia DR3 2537649197407027584, Gaia DR3 2123475575386817920. The abstract (T:p1-b6) and Table 2 (I:p8-b6) say eight high-v sin i HVS candidates, but Table 1 and the Appendix list seven; no eighth ID is supplied, so only the seven explicit IDs are recorded. The Appendix lists indices 1-53 although the text says the final sample has 54 (I:p16-b0; I:p17-b0); the missing star is not identifiable. No follow_up entries are added: known high-velocity stars were filtered out (T:p3-b8), and the prior classifications mentioned for retained stars (BHB, WD, sdB/hot subdwarf, M13 HB, blue straggler) are not prior Galactic-unbound candidacies.

Gaia DR3 2515789291339579648: Target is Gaia DR3 2515789291339579648, index 1 in both Table 1 and the Appendix table; Table 1 notes that its index corresponds to the final Appendix table. Slightly different values are reported for the same star: v_grf^MS = 936 ± 123 km/s (Table 1, T:p7-b6), v_GRF = 928 ± 151 km/s (Appendix table, T:p16-b0), and an abstract Galactocentric velocity upper-limit of 934 ± 110 km/s (T:p1-b6); the abstract distance is 95 ± 13 kpc while the Appendix gives 95.43^{+16.29}_{-10.87} kpc. Section 6.1 (T:p6-b7) states that because [Fe/H] = -1 is a grid-boundary value, the distance and velocity estimates are upper bounds. The supplied material does not report individual right ascension, declination, parallax, or proper-motion components for this star.

Gaia DR3 3677213628601638656: Target Gaia DR3 3677213628601638656 is index 2 in Table 1 and in the appendix table. The paper reports two slightly different Galactocentric rest-frame velocities for it: 604 ± 118 km/s in Table 1 and 586 ± 75 km/s in the appendix table; both are retained. The unbound probability is given as 99% in Table 1 and 0.99 in the appendix table, i.e. the same result in different units. Table 1 R_sph is explicitly the present-day Galactocentric radius assuming MS nature. No right ascension, declination, parallax, or proper-motion components are reported for this target.

Gaia DR3 2564538681977454208: Target Gaia DR3 2564538681977454208 is identified in T:p7-b8 and is index 3 in the final Appendix table; T:p7-b6 states that Table 1 indices correspond to that appendix table. For this same object, Table 1 gives v_GRF = 450 ± 83 km/s and P_unbound = 56%, while the Appendix table gives v_GRF = 458 ± 138 km/s and P_unbound = 0.52; the paper does not explain the difference, so both reported results are retained. No equatorial coordinates, parallax, or proper motions for this target are reported in the supplied material.

Gaia DR3 1890511670168860416: For Gaia DR3 1890511670168860416, Table 1 gives v_grf^MS = 435 ± 50 km/s and p_unbound^MS = 63%, while the appendix final table gives v_GRF = 447 ± 72 km/s and P_unbound = 0.65; both reported sets are retained because they differ (T:p7-b6, T:p16-b0). No right ascension, declination, parallax, or proper-motion values are reported for this star.

Gaia DR3 4584485956183915776: Target is Gaia DR3 4584485956183915776 (index 5 in the final sample). Table 1 (T:p7-b6) and the Appendix table (T:p16-b0, I:p16-b0) give slightly different values for the Galactocentric rest-frame velocity (705 ± 55 vs 695 ± 78 km/s) and plane-crossing radius (48.2 ± 5.0 kpc in the table vs 48.5 ± 5.1 kpc in the text at T:p7-b2); both reported values are recorded where eligible. R_cross (48.2 kpc) is a Galactic-plane crossing radius, not the present-day Galactocentric radius, and is therefore not extracted as galactocentric_radius. No individual right ascension, declination, parallax, or proper-motion values are reported for this star; its parallax is not among the reliable ones (Fig. 2).

Gaia DR3 2537649197407027584: The target is Gaia DR3 2537649197407027584 (index 6). T:p7-b6/I:p7-b6 (Table 1) give v_grf^MS = 440 ± 48 km/s and p_unbound^MS = 52%, while T:p16-b0/I:p16-b0 (Appendix table, index 6) give v_GRF = 421 ± 44 km/s and P_unbound = 0.21. The paper does not explain this discrepancy, so both reported values are retained. The text at T:p7-b9 quotes an estimated RV of ∼−370 km/s, consistent with the exact table value −368 ± 10 km/s, and also reports the earlier heliocentric RV −434 km/s. No right ascension, declination, parallax, or proper-motion values specific to this star are reported in the supplied material.

Gaia DR3 2123475575386817920: For Gaia DR3 2123475575386817920 (index 7), the paper reports slightly different values for v_GRF and P_unbound in Table 1 versus the Appendix table: 585 ± 68 km/s and 78% in Table 1, and 587 ± 77 km/s and 0.74 in the Appendix. Both are retained rather than selecting one. The Appendix value 25.8 ± 6.5 kpc is R_cross, the Galactic plane-crossing radius, not the present-day Galactocentric radius; it is not used for galactocentric_radius. No right ascension, declination, parallax, or proper-motion components for this target are reported in the supplied material.

Gaia DR3 2572040752892873984: The target is Gaia DR3 2572040752892873984, corresponding to index 8 in both the Appendix final-sample table and Table 1. Table 1 provides separate main-sequence and BHB-nature kinematic solutions; the Appendix v_GRF = 858 ± 139 km/s and P_unbound = 1.00 correspond to the main-sequence-like solution. The Table 1 R_sph = 114 ± 14 kpc is a Galactocentric radius, not the heliocentric distance.

Gaia DR3 2648181555159543552: Target Gaia DR3 2648181555159543552 is index 9 in Table 1 (T:p7-b6) and in the Appendix table (T:p16-b0). Table 1 provides separate main-sequence and BHB kinematic values; the Appendix gives a slightly different adopted v_GRF (829 ± 126 km/s) and P_unbound = 1.00 for the same BHB-HVS candidate, so both reported values are retained. The supplied material does not report equatorial coordinates, parallax, or proper-motion components for this star.

Gaia DR3 3588442637484171008: The target Gaia DR3 3588442637484171008 is Appendix index 10 (T:p16-b0); Table 1's note states that indices correspond to the final Appendix table (T:p7-b6). Table 1 reports two sets of kinematic values for this low-v sin i object: MS-assumption v_grf=760±86 km/s and p_unbound=98%, and BHB-assumption v_grf=286±33 km/s and p_unbound=0%; the Appendix lists v_GRF=710±129 km/s and P_unbound=0.95 for the BHB-HVS flag. The paper does not explain these differences.
